_comment: Fields allowlisted per route for the SEO parity compare (Task 18). '_comment' keys are ignored by diffRoute (only `field: true` allowlists). Default stance: baseline is truth — every entry below is a provably semantics-preserving diff, justified inline. The twitterTitle/twitterDescription/ogTitle entries share one root cause: Next 16 postProcessMetadata (node_modules/next/dist/lib/metadata/resolve-metadata.js) UNCONDITIONALLY autofills twitter title/description from openGraph (and og/twitter title from the page title) whenever any openGraph exists — there is no metadata-API off switch. The autofilled values byte-match each page's own og:title/description, so the tags are additive and correct; the CRA site simply never emitted them.
